Commentary.Commentary: Right then. That is all that we have from this game. Namibia make their way to the Super 12s and Ireland will catch a flight back home as they miss out this time around. We have one final game before the Super 12s get underway and the final game of Group A between Sri Lanka and Netherlands will get underway at 6 pm local (2 pm GMT). Switch tabs and catch all the action from that game. Cheers!

The captain of Namibia, Gerhard Erasmus, says that they are a small cricketing nation and this win means a lot to them. Mentions that they are very proud of themselves tonight. Adds that Wiese is the senior player of the team and has stepped up in crucial situations. Tells that the win has not sunk in yet but maybe it will soon.

Andy Balbirnie, the skipper of Ireland, says the side is surely gutted but says they will come back stronger in future campaigns. Also praises the effort of Namibia and says they were the better side.

DAVID WIESE IS THE PLAYER OF THE MATCH! Wiese says it is very overwhelming. Adds the captain deserves to pick up this trophy and it was a proper captain's innings. Mentions the team has worked really hard and this was a strong performance from them.

Earlier in the day, after a really fruitful Powerplay from the Irish openers, they lost the plot and keep losing wickets regularly and were not able to capitalize on the good start to end on just 126. In the end, the total was just not enough for the Irish bowlers to defend and they have crashed out of the tournament.

Not the best bowling display by Ireland. They did well in the first 10 overs as they kept the run flow in check but failed to keep picking wickets. With the total not being a massive one, regular wickets was what Ireland needed but they never got them. They only managed 2 wickets and had they taken more scalps throughout the innings, they could have made life difficult for Namibia. Curtis Campher was the pick of the lot as he took 2 wickets and Josh Little bowled well too, but, it was not meant to be.

The start by Namibia was slow like a sloth as there was no quickness in their innings early on. They struggled to get going and only managed to score 27 runs, losing one wicket, in the Powerplay. They needed to get through the middle overs well and the duo of Gerhard Erasmus and Zane Green did that with their 48-run stand, which was slow again, but they did what was needed from them. The running between these two was the highlight as they did well to run hard and grab a couple of runs whenever possible. Green fell and the hero of the last game, David Wiese walked out. The 15th over changed the momentum for Namibia as they gathered 16 off that over. After that, the duo of Erasmus and Wiese played smartly and kept the run rate in check, with the skipper getting his fifty, and they took their team over the line, with 9 balls to spare.

A nation rejoices now! Namibia have done it! What a big moment this is for Namibian cricket as they have booked their place in the Super 12s. They have fought hard and have deservedly made their way to the next stage of this tournament. All the players will be very glad that their tournament can continue and it does not end prematurely. Ireland, on the other hand, will be mighty disappointed that they have failed to cross this hurdle and it will take them a while to get over this.

FOUR! Here comes the winning runs. David Wiese racks up the winning runs. A full-length ball, outside off. Wiese puts all his power on this shot. He slashes it over cover. The ball clears the man in the deep and goes into the boundary on a bounce. Emotional scenes for Namibia cricket. The skipper is on his knees. The dugout can't believe it. History has been made by Namibia here. THEY WIN THE GAME BY 8 WICKETS.
Slower, full-length ball, on off. Eramus pushes it to mid off for a single.

FOUR! Gerhard Erasmus is in a hurry to end things here. Fuller in length, outside off. Erasmus leans in and lifts it over covers for a boundary. He also brings up his half-century in style. A captain's knock by Erasmus.
Craig Young (3-0-24-0) comes back on.
Tossed up, on middle. Erasmus makes room and lifts it over covers for a single. Ireland are chasing the game now, this over has changed the context of the game. 9 runs needed off 12.
A single now! Short and outside off. Wiese cuts it to backward point for a run.
Flighted, full and on leg. Wiese pushes it back to the bowler.
WIDE! Full and sliding down leg. Wiese leaves it alone. Wide called by the umpire.
Flatter and on off. Erasmus pushes it to cover for a single.

SIX! Magnificent strike by Erasmus. He uses his feet really well here. Floated, full and on off. Gerhard Erasmus skips down the track and smokes it over the long off fence for a biggie. Namibia are nearly there.
A couple now! Tossed up, on off. Erasmus makes room and lifts it over extra cover. The ball lands safely. The batters pick two runs.
Simi Singh is brought back into the attack.
Great over by Little. Just 5 runs off it. A full-length ball, outside off. Erasmus guides it to third man for a run. 21 runs needed off 18 balls.
A run a ball, does keep the game interesting at this stage. Full and outside off. Wiese steers it towards third man for another run.
Short ball, on middle and leg. Erasmus pulls it to deep square leg for another single.
Full-length ball, on off. Wiese swings his blade hard at it. The ball goes towards mid-wicket and for a single.
A length ball, around off, nipping in. Erasmus flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Swing and a miss! Little comes from 'round the wicket. Back of a length and outside off. Erasmus looks to cut it away but misses.
Josh Little comes back on.
Slower and full, outside off. David Wiese lifts it to deep extra cover for a brace. 100 up for Namibia! 26 needed from 24 balls.
Length ball, on leg. Gerhard Erasmus looks to flick but misses. Gets hit on the pads and the batters take a leg bye.
Fuller in length, on middle, worked to long on for a run.
Short of a length, on off. Erasmus gets behind the line of the ball and drops it towards point. The batters tee off for a run.
Length ball, outside off. David Wiese slashes it to deep point for one.
On off, Gerhard Erasmus steps out and flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On a length, on off. Gerhard Erasmus punches it through covers for a single. 33 needed from 30 balls.

NOT OUT! Length ball, on off. Gerhard Erasmus looks to defend but misses. The ball goes through the gate to the keeper. Neil Rock and Craig Young appeal for a caught behind but the umpire says no. Ireland take a review. UltraEdge shows a flat line as the ball passes the bat. Gerhard Erasmus survives. The ball brushed the off pole slightly but the bails did not fall off and hence, this will be not out.
Review for caught behind! Replays show that there was no bat on this one.
Length ball, outside off. David Wiese works it towards covers for a single now.
SIX! WHOA! David Wiese is picking up right from where he left off. Young again pitches it short, short enough for David Wiese to hammer it over deep mid-wicket for another biggie.

SIX! BANG! Short of a length, on off. David Wiese launches this one over deep mid-wicket. The fielder manages to get his hand to it but the ball falls over the ropes. David Wiese has his intentions clear.
Short of a length, on middle. David Wiese pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
On off, punched to sweeper cover for a single.
On a good length, on off. Gerhard Erasmus dabs it towards backward point. Harry Tector quickly collects the ball and has a shy at the striker's end but misses. Had that hit, David Wiese was a goner.
Back of a length, on middle. Wiese hangs back and knocks it to mid on for one.
On a length, on off. Gerhard Erasmus works it to long off for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! Curtis Campher gets the much-needed breakthrough. It is once again Kevin O'Brien who takes a stunner. Curtis Campher bowls it on a good length, on off. Zane Green uses his feet and lifts it towards mid off. He doesn't manage to clear the man and Kevin O'Brien back-pedals, leaps, and takes the catch. Namibia lose their second wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Kevin O'Brien b Curtis Campher

Commentary.Commentary: Out walks David Wiese. He was on fire in the last game. Can he replicate the same and take Namibia to the Super 12s?
Full and outside off, Zane Green steps out and lofts it towards deep cover for a couple of runs.

FOUR! Nicely played! Short of a length, on off. Gerhard Erasmus rocks back and guides it right into the gap between backward point and third man. The ball races away to the boundary. A good over for Namibia. 10 runs from it. 55 more needed from 42 balls.
Curtis Campher (1-0-2-1) comes back on.
On a length, on off. Gerhard Erasmus knocks it back to the bowler.
On leg, Zane Green eases it down to long on for a single.
Right on the money! Little bowls a yorker, on middle. Zane Green jams it out.
On middle, flicked to deep square leg for a single. Gerhard Erasmus wants the second run but settles for one.
FOUR! There comes the boundary Namibia were looking for. Josh Little bowls it on a length, outside off. Gerhard Erasmus rocks back and cuts it past point.
Josh Little (2-0-7-0) is back on now.
7 off this over! Around off, pushed through covers for one. 65 needed in 48 balls!
On middle and leg, Gerhard Erasmus walks forward and chips this over mid on. They take two again.
BYE. Tosses this one up, fuller outside off, Zane Green gets low and looks to sweep but misses. The keeper misses too and the batters sneak a bye.
Just one run this time as GE flicks this through mid-wicket.
Fuller again, this time around middle and leg, Gerhard Erasmus works this through mid on and they run the first one hard. Come back nicely for the second too.
Fuller, outside off, GE looks to play the reverse-hit to the off side but fails to connect.
Just 5 off this over! Outside off, slapped to the right of point for one.
A dot now! Back of a length, on off, punched straight to point.
Another pull shot, this time by Green, to the right of deep mid-wicket for a run.
On a shortish length, around off, Gerhard Erasmus goes back and pumps this to deep mid-wicket for one.
On middle, worked through mid on for one more.
Good-length ball on off, nudged through mid-wicket for a single. 50 up for Namibia!
Full on off, hit back to Singh. At the halfway stage, Namibia are at 49/1 and need 77 more from 60 balls.

DRINKS! Namibia have started off slowly, but they do have a lot of wickets in hand which will let the batters shift gears and start the attack very soon. Ireland, on the other hand, have been brilliant with the ball. They have stemmed the run flow and would hope to chip wickets at regular intervals, to put the pressure on Namibia.
WIDE. Down the leg side, the sweep is missed.
Loopy, outside off, GE steps out and nudges this through mid-wicket. They take one and look for another but they do no go for it in the end.
Good call for two and they get it! Slower through the air, fuller around off, Gerhard Erasmus works this through mid-wicket. They take the first one quickly and come back for the second.
Floated, outside off, punched down to long off for a run.
GE skips down to this fuller ball and tucks it through mid-wicket for one.
Good running! Fuller, around off, Gerhard steps out and tucks this through square leg. The skipper wants two and runs hard to complete the second.
Simi Singh to continue. He is into his second over.
Short of a length, around off, punched through point for a run.
Width offered outside off, slapped through covers for a single.
A touch short, around off this time, Zane Green goes deep in the crease and pulls this to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Outside off, on a length, pushed through covers for a single.
Good-length on off, pushed to covers.
Around off, on a length, punched down to long off for one.
Slower through the air, on off. Gerhard Erasmus hangs back and punches it to the right of the bowler.
Loopy ball, outside off. Gerhard Erasmus dabs it to backward point.
Tosses it up, outside off. Green steers it past point for a single.
Floats it up, outside off. Driven straight to covers.
Full and outside off, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball, on off. Gerhard Erasmus pushes it back to the bowler.
Spin time! Simi Singh to roll his arm.
Short of a length, on off. Zane Green hops and punches it towards covers.
FOUR! Edgy! Good-length ball, outside off. Zane Green looks to drive. The ball goes off the outside edge and races away to the third man fence.
On a length, on middle. Gerhard Erasmus works it behind square on the leg side for a run.
Mark Adair is hobbling off and he seems to have a side-strain. He looks to be in some pain and it does not look like he will continue to bowl. Kevin O'Brien to complete the over.

Good-length ball, on middle and leg, angling in. Gerhard Erasmus looks to defend but misses. Mark Adair appeals for an LBW but the umpire says no. Ireland do not take a review. They really should have taken it as replays show that the ball would go onto hit the wickets. Gerhard Erasmus is given a new lease of life.
Good-length ball, on middle. Gerhard Erasmus hangs back and pushes it to cover.
On the pads, tucked to deep square leg for a single.
Change. Mark Adair comes back on.

No, he cannot. Erasmus get off the mark. Full and on the pads. Erasmus clears his front leg and flicks it to mid-wicket. The batters call for two and get two. If the throw from the fielder was better to the bowler, Namibia could've lost another wicket. At the end of the Powerplay, Namibia are 27/1.
Four dots in a row! A full-length ball, on off. Erasmus drives it to cover. Can Campher make it a wicket-maiden over?
Length and on middle. Erasmus blocks it out.
Good length and around off. The ball nips in. Gerhard Erasmus shows the full face of the bat and works it towards mid on.
Full and on off. Gerhard Erasmus pushes it to cover.
The skipper, Gerhard Erasmus walks out to bat at No.3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Kevin O'Brien takes a blinder. Curtis Campher comes into the attack and gets the big wicket of Craig Williams. A length ball, around middle and leg. Williams hangs back and looks to clear the man at mid on, but he does not get much elevation on it. Kevin O'Brien there leaps and takes a stunning catch. He is up and celebrating. What an important breakthrough. It is a huge blow for Namibia.
Commentary.Howout: c Kevin O'Brien b Curtis Campher

Commentary.Commentary: Curtis Campher is brought into the attack. He replaces Mark Adair.
On the pads, flicked to deep square leg. The batters pick two easily. Just 4 runs off it.
Great save by Andy Balbirnie. A short ball, on off. Green hangs back and pulls it to mid-wicket. Andy Balbirnie there dives to his left and makes a half-stop.
Good length and on off. Green takes a step forward and blocks it to cover.
A length ball, on the stumps. Green defends it out wacthfully.
A full-length ball, on the pads. Green clips it to deep square leg and picks up a brace.
Green misses out on the full toss. A slower, full toss, outside off. Green slashes it to cover but straight to the man.
Craig Young comes back into the attack. Went for 4 runs in his first over.
A length ball, on the pads. Green tucks it to square leg and takes off for a single. A good over for Namibia. 10 runs off it. They would look to make the most of the Powerplay.
On a length, outside off. Green stays back and defends it to cover.
Back of a length, on off. Williams stays back and pushes it to point for a single.
FOUR! In the gap! Outside off, Craig Williams stands up on his toes and punches it through cover-point for a boundary.
Back of a length, on off. Craig Williams punches it towards covers. Paul Stirling dives to his right and makes an excellent stop. Saves a certain boundary.
Mark Adair is introduced into the attack.
FOUR! What a shot! Width on offer, outside off. Craig Williams slices it over the covers for a boundary.
Around middle, Craig flicks this through square leg for one.
A searing yorker, around off, Green tucks this one towards mid on for a quick single.
WIDE. A shortish ball, down the leg side, Zane Green looks to pull this one but misses. Wide signalled.
On a length on off, Green pushes it back to the bowler, who collects the ball and has a shy at the striker's end but misses.
Good-length ball, outside off. Zane Green looks to punch it on the off side but only manages to toe-end it on the track.
Fuller and on middle, Green clips it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Back of a length, on off. Zane Green chops it back to the keeper as he looks to slash it away.
WIDE! Full and down leg. Green hangs back and looks to flick it away but misses. Wide called.
On a length, around off. Williams pushes it to covers. The fielder there dives to his right to make a good stop. A great start by Craig Young, just 4 runs off it.
Around off, pushed to covers.

FOUR! SHOT! Good use of the feet by Williams. He comes forward to this length ball, on off. He smacks it over the bowler's head and bags a boundary. Craig Williams gets the first boundary of the chase.
Three dots on the trot! Length ball, around middle and off. Williams defends it back to the bowler.
Good length and on off. Williams stays on the back foot and pushes it to cover.
A length ball, on off. Williams stays back and defends it out.
Craig Young to bowl from the other end.

An appeal for lbw but turned down by the umpire. Full length and on leg. Green looks to flick it away but misses. He gets rapped on the pads. Little appeals but the umpire says no. Andy Balbirnie decides to go against the review. A great start by Josh Little, only 1 run off it.
Green gets beaten by pace here. Good-length ball, outside off. Green looks to cut it away but misses.

Namibia are underway! A full-length ball, outside off. Williams reaches out as he look to slash it through cover. The ball takes the outside edge and goes towards deep backward point. The batters cross for a single.
Three dots on the trot! A length ball, around off. Williams stays back and taps it to point.
Full and on off. Williams hangs back and drives it to cover, but could not find the gap.
A full-length ball, shaping in. Williams comes forward and flicks it to mid-wicket.
